cueCard.topic: Describe a park or garden that you like to visit.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you like this place.

questions.text: Describe a park or garden that you like to visit.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a park or garden that you like to visit. You should say: where it is; how often you go there; what you do there; and explain why you like this place.

questions.text: Do many people visit this place?
questions.say: Thank you. Do many people visit this place?

questions.text: Why are parks important in big cities?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a park or garden you like to visit, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all green spaces in cities. Why are parks important in big cities?

questions.text: Should new housing areas always include a park?
